name: I Can Win It Back (Skeletal Draft)
status_note: 39-card Gambling Dad lab draft. Poker testing now uses Gain 2 Ready Stash / Draw 2 on a win; lose 2 Stash + discard 1 hand card on loss; Breaking Point unlocks optional one-time-per-sequence Double Down.
watchpoints: Does choosing Draw 2 outpace normal card advantage?
Does +2 Stash remain worth taking early?
At 10 Composure, do players choose Double Down when behind?
Is the 2-Stash-and-1-discard loss penalty meaningful without wiping Characters?
Do per-hand win triggers become overwhelming on Double Down?
Does playing two poker hands take too long?
